privacy.title: Privacy notice

seo.title: Privacy notice — Sophia’s Garden
seo.description: Information about enquiries and personal information submitted through the Sophia’s Garden website.

privacy.body:
## Draft — complete before launch

This notice must be reviewed and completed by the resort operator before collecting real enquiries.

## Who operates this website

Add the full legal business name, address and privacy contact.

## Information you submit

Our enquiry form requests your name, email address and message. Our opening-updates form requests your name, email address and permission to send opening news.

## Service providers

Website forms are processed using Netlify. Website code and public media are stored using GitHub. If you load or visit our booking engine, Cloudbeds processes booking information under the applicable booking and privacy terms.

## Retention and your rights

Specify your retention periods, applicable rights, international processing arrangements and how visitors can request access, correction, deletion or withdrawal of marketing permission.

## Cookies and external services

This starter website does not load advertising or analytics tags. The booking engine may use its own cookies and storage when loaded. Update this notice and your consent implementation before adding analytics or advertising.

faqs.question: Where is Sophia’s Garden?
faqs.answer: Sophia’s Garden is in Coron, Palawan, Philippines. See the contact page for the property address and ask our team for current arrival guidance.

faqs.question: When will reservations reopen?
faqs.answer: The planned reopening is in early 2027, subject to confirmation. Request opening updates or contact the team for the latest information.

faqs.question: Can the team help with excursions?
faqs.answer: Contact the team to discuss locally available excursions. Operators, weather conditions, prices and availability are confirmed separately.

rooms.body:
A place to put down your bags and take the day a little slower. Our 19 m² Superior Twin has two single beds and a terrace with garden views, a comfortable base for friends or travel companions discovering Coron.

Head out for a day on the water, or keep your plans closer to the pool. Come evening, return to your own quiet corner of Sophia’s Garden.
rooms.summary: A simple retreat to share, with twin beds and a terrace looking onto the garden.

gallery.caption: Botanical concept artwork. Room photography will follow.

seo.title: Superior Room — Sophia’s Garden, Coron
seo.description: Stay in the Superior Twin at Sophia’s Garden in Coron, Palawan. A 19 m² room with two single beds, a terrace and garden views.

rooms.body:
Simple, comfortable, and easy to settle into. Our 19 m² Superior Double pairs a double bed with a terrace overlooking the garden.

Start your morning slowly before heading out to explore Coron. Whether the day takes you to the lagoons or no further than the pool, there’s somewhere peaceful to come back to.
rooms.summary: A cosy room for two, with a double bed and a little space beside the garden.

gallery.caption: Botanical concept artwork. Room photography will follow.

rooms.body:
Space to unpack and make yourself at home. Our 48 m² Deluxe Room brings together a queen bed and a single bed, with a balcony looking onto the garden.

It’s an easy place to share with family or friends, between island outings and unhurried meals at El Comidor. Leave a little time for the garden, too.
rooms.summary: Our most spacious stay, with room to settle in a little longer with a queen bed, a single bed, and garden views.

gallery.caption: Botanical concept artwork. Suite photography will follow.

rooms.title: Deluxe Room

seo.title: Premier Deluxe Room
seo.description: Stay together in the 48 m² Premier Deluxe Quad at Sophia’s Garden, Coron. Two single beds, a bunk bed, a balcony and garden views.

rooms.title: Premier Deluxe Quad
rooms.summary: A shared stay for four, with twin beds, a bunk bed, and a balcony above the garden.
rooms.body:
For trips with friends and family days away. Our 48 m² Premier Deluxe Quad has two single beds and a bunk bed, giving four guests a comfortable place to return to after exploring Coron.

Enjoy the garden views from your balcony, gather for a meal, and make tomorrow’s plans together. Some days are best when there’s someone to share them with.

seo.title: Family Room
seo.description: Make yourself at home in the 48 m² Family Room at Sophia’s Garden, Coron. Two queen beds, a balcony, and views of the pool or garden.

rooms.title: Family Room
rooms.summary: Room for four to make themselves at home, with two queen beds and a private balcony.
rooms.body:
A comfortable place for the whole day’s stories. Our 48 m² Family Room has two queen beds and a balcony overlooking the pool or garden, with space for up to four guests.

Spend your days exploring Coron together or enjoying a slower afternoon at the resort. When it’s time to come in, settle down, and start thinking about tomorrow, your room is ready.

seo.title: Honeymoon Room
seo.description: Enjoy time for two in the 48 m² Honeymoon Room at Sophia’s Garden, Coron, with a king bed, a balcony and views of the pool or garden.

rooms.title: Honeymoon Room
rooms.summary: A little time for two, with a king bed and a balcony overlooking the pool or garden.
rooms.body:
For a new beginning, an anniversary, or simply time away together. Our 48 m² Honeymoon Room offers a king bed and a balcony with views of the pool or garden.

Ease into the morning, spend the day discovering Coron, and return for a quiet evening at Sophia’s Garden. There’s room to slow down and enjoy each other’s company.
